usageNotes: Use this to inspect a specific ZFS pool's health on a given node — including its vdev layout, per-vdev read/write/checksum error counters, overall pool state (ONLINE/DEGRADED/FAULTED), and the last scrub result. Requires the Sys.Audit privilege at the root path; API tokens are supported. The node must be online and ZFS must be loaded — pools on offline or unreachable nodes will return an error, not empty data.

examples.summary: Get details for the 'rpool' ZFS pool on node 'pve1'

tips: The 'children' array is nested: top-level entries represent vdev groups (e.g. 'mirror-0', 'cache', 'spares'), and their children are the individual member disks.
Non-zero 'cksum', 'read', or 'write' counters on a vdev child indicate I/O errors — a pool in ONLINE state can still have silent errors accumulating.
The 'scan' field contains the last scrub timestamp and result; an empty or missing value means no scrub has ever completed.
The optional 'action' field surfaces ZFS's own recommended remediation step (e.g. 'resilver in progress', 'replace the disk') — useful to surface directly in alerts.
Use list_nodes_node_disks_zfs to enumerate all pool names on a node before calling this endpoint.
